summary: Aegon Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 26, 2026, announcing the filing of a Form F-4 registration statement (Shareholder Circular) for its proposed redomiciliation from Bermuda to the United States. The filing precedes an Extraordinary General Meeting expected on October 8, 2026, where shareholders will vote on the redomiciliation proposal, governance documents, and an Omnibus Incentive Plan. Vereniging Aegon, holding approximately 18.4% of voting rights, has agreed to vote in favor via a Voting Undertaking Agreement. This is a regulatory filing related to a corporate reorganisation, not a change-of-control transaction, and does not constitute a special-situation event like a spin-off or acquisition.
